{{for|the carrion servants of the [[Shadow]]|Dark One's eyes (carrion)}}
'''The Dark One's Eyes''' is a name for a roll of five dice where each die shows a single pip in games where it is a losing toss.{{ref/book|3|32}}{{ref/book|11|11}} While the same toss can be a winning toss in other games, such tosses are not referred to as the [[Dark One]]'s eyes.{{ref/book|3|32}} The term may apply in situations where it is neither the winning nor losing toss. It is considered unlucky.{{ref/book|11|11}}
{{tocright}}

==Metaphor==

The concept of dice - such as those which produce the rattling sound in [[Mat Cauthon]]'s head - turning up as the Dark One's eyes metaphorically refers to something bad happening, or to bad luck in general.{{ref/book|5|44}}{{ref/book|6|49}}{{ref/book|10|28}}

==Parallels==

In the game {{Wiki|Yahtzee}} the valuable eponymous dice roll occurs when the five dice yield identical results.
